label: Pro 2.1.0
title: Import releases, hear from readers
lede: Pro 2.1.0 pulls release notes from Linear, Jira and Notion into your approval workflow, and lets readers react and comment under each release. Both run on your own backend and database.

items.title: Import from Linear, Jira and Notion
items.text: Read cycles, versions and pages from the tracker your team already uses. Every release arrives as a draft with a link per entry, never straight in the feed.
items.code:
export LINEAR_API_KEY=...   # never committed
npx derivative-segments import --source linear --team ENG --since 2026-01-01
npx derivative-segments import --source jira --url https://acme.atlassian.net --project WEB
npx derivative-segments import --source notion --database <id> --props published=Live

items.title: Safe to run again
items.text: Imports read all pages and retry on rate limits and server errors. A draft already in review or approved is never overwritten, and labels map to entry types.
items.code: npx derivative-segments import --source jira --url https://acme.atlassian.net --project WEB --map bug=fix,story=feature

items.title: Reactions and comments per release
items.text: Add a comment handler to your backend and one line to the page. Readers open the section under a release, and nothing loads before that.

items.title: Moderation you control
items.text: Comments are plain text and held back until you approve them. A protected handler lists, approves, rejects or deletes them.

note: The demo cannot show these: the import needs your own tracker account (it is Beta, tested against mock servers only) and comments need your own backend and database.
